# Porty

> A modern Framer-based personal portfolio template showcasing design and development services with professional case studies and industry insights.

Porty is a premium portfolio template built on Framer that demonstrates web design, development, and branding capabilities through real client work and thought leadership content. The site features multiple case studies, service offerings, and a blog covering contemporary design and development trends.

## Key Topics

- Framer
- Web Design
- Web Development
- UI/UX Design
- Portfolio Template
- Branding
- Design Services
- Development Services
- Case Studies
- Design Tools
- Figma
- User-Centered Design
- Design Process
- Agency Services
- Client Work

## Core Portfolio

- [Porty - Personal Portfolio Framer Template](https://porty.framer.ai): Main landing page for Porty personal portfolio template built with Framer for designers
- [Projects Showcase](https://porty.framer.ai/projects): Portfolio project showcase with design and development case studies
- [Web Design Services](https://porty.framer.ai/web-design): Web design services using Framer, Figma and modern design tools
- [Development Services](https://porty.framer.ai/development): Web development services using Framer and modern development tools
- [Branding Services](https://porty.framer.ai/branding): Branding services including visual identity and logo design

## Client Case Studies

- [Swisss Mobile App Redesign](https://porty.framer.ai/projects/swisss-mobile-app-redesign): Swisss mobile app redesign case study with UX/UI strategy
- [Italic Web Development](https://porty.framer.ai/projects/italic-web-development): Italic web development agency project portfolio case study
- [Swat Agency Stack](https://porty.framer.ai/projects/swat-agency-stack): Swat Agency Stack branding and workflow optimization case study
- [Forge Webworks](https://porty.framer.ai/projects/forge-webworks): Forge Webworks agency web design and development case study
- [Mac Cloud Linker](https://porty.framer.ai/projects/mac-cloud-linker): Mac Cloud Linker cloud integration and app development case study

## Blog & Insights

- [Blog Home](https://porty.framer.ai/blogs): Blog section featuring design insights and web development trends
- [UI Trends That Actually Works Best](https://porty.framer.ai/blogs/ui-trends-that-actually-works-best): Article on effective UI design trends including dark mode and accessibility
- [Trends in Development](https://porty.framer.ai/blogs/trends-in-development): Article covering current development trends and best practices
- [Crafting UCD from Day One](https://porty.framer.ai/blogs/crafting-ucd-from-day-one): Article on user-centered design methodology and implementation
- [Analysis in Creative Project](https://porty.framer.ai/blogs/analysis-in-creative-project): Article on design analysis and creative project strategy
- [Art of Clean Code in Web](https://porty.framer.ai/blogs/art-of-clean-code-in-web): Article on code quality, best practices and web development standards
